label: Paragraph
intent: A paragraph break is set, like a carriage return: the pilcrow's two stems run down from the foot of the bowl to the baseline in turn, and the mark takes their landing. Light: both stems are pulled up to the foot of the bowl (the bowl's counter stays closed), then drop one after the other and stop dead on the baseline; the mark squashes onto the baseline as the second lands and springs back. Strong: the stems visibly roll up to the bowl first, then drop harder in turn; the mark squashes deeper, rebounds and settles.

mark.//: squashes onto the baseline the stems land on

stem-a.draw.//: never shorter than 0.5 (y 15.5): stem-a closes the bowl's counter, which set 29 keeps open in every frame

stem-b.draw.//: retracts with stem-a, drops 70 ms after it
